proposals.statement:
theorem leftDiagonal_step_onset_dichotomy (m q N : ℕ)
    (h0 : PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal m) q N)
    (h1 : PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal (m + 1)) q N) :
    PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal (m + 2)) (2 * q) (N + 1) ∨
      ∃ j, N ≤ j ∧ leftDiagonal (m + 1) (j + 1) = true ∧
        PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal (m + 2)) q (j + 1) := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: Any proof of leftDiagonal_onset_le is an induction on the diagonal index that must bound where the onset lands at each step, and this is the only statement on the board that keeps that index in both branches: the closed leftDiagonal_step_period_dichotomy reports the black branch as a bare `∃ M` and gives the white branch no periodicity at all, so it cannot be iterated into any onset bound.
proposals.disclaims: Does not prove leftDiagonal_onset_le and does not bound the onset at all. Iterating it gives onset ≤ (sum of the first-black gaps over the first k diagonals), and nothing here bounds those gaps — that sum being at most k is exactly what remains open. It also bears on no prize conjecture: it is about the settled edge of the cone, not the centre column. It is not a restatement of the wall, which quantifies over k and asserts a numeric bound; this is one induction step with the bound left free.

route.tactics:
by_cases hb : ∃ j, N ≤ j ∧ leftDiagonal (m + 1) (j + 1) = true
  · obtain ⟨j, hj, hbj⟩ := hb
    exact Or.inr ⟨j, hj, hbj,
      leftDiagonal_periodicFrom_step_of_black m q N j hj h0 h1 hbj⟩
  · push_neg at hb
    have hw : ∀ j, N + 1 ≤ j → leftDiagonal (m + 1) j = false := by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = i + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
      simpa using hb i (by omega)
    refine Or.inl ?_
    have hrec : ∀ i : ℕ, leftDiagonal (m + 2) (N + 1 + i + 1)
        = xor (leftDiagonal (m + 2) (N + 1 + i)) (leftDiagonal m (N + 1 + i + 2)) := by
      intro i
      have R := leftDiagonal_recurrence m (N + 1 + i)
      rw [hw (N + 1 + i + 1) (by omega), Bool.false_or, Bool.xor_comm] at R
      exact R
    have hc : PeriodicFrom (fun i => leftDiagonal m (N + 1 + i + 2)) q 0 := by
      intro i _
      have hi := h0 (N + 1 + i + 2) (by omega)
      show leftDiagonal m (N + 1 + (i + q) + 2) = leftDiagonal m (N + 1 + i + 2)
      rw [show N + 1 + (i + q) + 2 = N + 1 + i + 2 + q from by omega]
      exact hi
    have hx := bool_xor_driven_periodicFrom (fun i => leftDiagonal m (N + 1 + i + 2))
        (fun i => leftDiagonal (m + 2) (N + 1 + i)) q 0 (fun i => hrec i) hc
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, n = N + 1 + i := ⟨n - (N + 1), by omega⟩
    have h2 := hx i (Nat.zero_le _)
    rw [show N + 1 + i + 2 * q = N + 1 + (i + 2 * q) from by omega]
    exact h2
